using Raw = std::string
class Refusal : public std::runtime_error
  const char* word
  std::size_t offset
enum class PageOutcome {Page, Gap, Unavailable, InvalidRequest, RecordTooLarge, Corrupt, Unsupported}
inline constexpr std::string_view wire_name(PageOutcome value)
inline std::optional<PageOutcome> parse_page_outcome(std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(PageOutcome value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(PageOutcome value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(std::string_view name, PageOutcome value)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, PageOutcome value)
inline const std::vector<std::string> kPageOutcomeNames
inline const std::vector<std::string> kServiceErrorCodeNames
inline constexpr std::string_view kServiceErrorCodeHandlerError

struct Attestation
  std::string by
  bool verified
  std::int64_t hop
  std::string program
  std::string host
  std::string user
  std::string exe
  std::int64_t uid
  std::int64_t gid
  std::int64_t pid
  std::string key
  std::string mac
struct Record
  std::int64_t schema
  std::string time
  std::int64_t level
  std::string msg
  std::vector<Attestation> identity
  std::string job
  std::map<std::string, std::string> attrs
struct Page
  PageOutcome outcome
  std::vector<Record> records
  std::string next
  bool at_end
inline std::string encode(const Record& v)
inline Record decode(std::string_view data)
struct FrameWriter
  virtual void write_frame(std::string_view frame)
struct DispatchError : std::runtime_error
inline std::string service_name(std::string_view frame)
struct FrameExchanger
  virtual std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame)
struct ServiceError : std::runtime_error
  std::string code, message
inline constexpr std::string_view kEndpointContract
struct DescribedService
  std::string contract
  bool ready
  std::string why
std::string describe_endpoint(std::string_view frame, const std::string& program, const std::string& version, const Services& . . . services)
struct Sink
  virtual void write(const Record& record)
template<class Transport>struct SinkClient : Sink
  Transport& transport_
  void write(const Record& record) override
struct SinkService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct SinkDispatcher : FrameWriter
  Sink& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
struct HistoryReader
  virtual Page read(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& max_records, const std::int64_t& max_bytes)
template<class Transport>struct HistoryReaderClient : HistoryReader
  Transport& transport_
  Page read(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& max_records, const std::int64_t& max_bytes) override
struct HistoryReaderService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct HistoryReaderDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  HistoryReader& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
struct HistoryObserver
  virtual Page observe(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& max_records, const std::int64_t& max_bytes, const std::int64_t& wait_ms)
template<class Transport>struct HistoryObserverClient : HistoryObserver
  Transport& transport_
  Page observe(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& max_records, const std::int64_t& max_bytes, const std::int64_t& wait_ms) override
struct HistoryObserverService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct HistoryObserverDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  HistoryObserver& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
